files.notes.md: Release notes for the ingest service. The parser now streams records instead of buffering them, which removes the memory ceiling we hit last quarter. Retries are capped at three attempts and the backoff is exponential. No schema changes shipped in this release, so downstream consumers need not redeploy anything at all today.
